notes: the first two co-transmitters meet at «عن أبي الأشهب» in one level
Tirmidhi's remarks naming Abd al-Rahman b. Tarafa and Sallam b. Zurayr name other transmitters for the same saying, so they are variant groups and not routes
«نحوه» is a wording note; the remarks on Ibn Mahdi's judgement and Abu Sa'd's name are commentary and are left out
